messages:
ops-bot: [INCIDENT] 2026-08-03T07:34:49Z — Elevated 500s and slow responses on hosted embeddings endpoints in us-west-2 caused by prefetch daemon backlog in the embed-store path. Fallback to direct master reads enabled. Tracking: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1923456789 :rotating_light:

Elena (oncall): Investigating now. Grafana shows prefetch queue depth spike and increased cold-loads to the backing store starting 07:30Z. Prefetcher process appears backlogged after a maintenance window.

Sam (eng-sre): Logs show repeated `prefetch: queue_full` and `store: read_timeout` from the embed-store coordinator. Snippet:
```
[07:31:02] prefetcher: queue_full count=183
[07:31:07] embed-store: read_timeout shard=3 host=es-3
```

Rina (support): Drafted a short customer note: "We're seeing intermittent failures and higher latency for embeddings in us-west-2. We've activated fallbacks and are mitigating; requests should succeed albeit slower. We'll update here." Will post to #support-updates and notify priority accounts.

Owen (infra): Mitigation: switching prefetcher to passive mode, restarting coordinator replicas, and provisioning two extra embed-store instances. Rolling restart in progress — ETA ~5m. Capturing heap snapshots and coordinator logs to s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/1923456789/ for RCA.

Priya (product): Confirm whether Dedicated/Private customers are affected — don't want to alarm them if not.

Elena (oncall): Dedicated/private deployments unaffected; problem limited to the multi-tenant us-west-2 prefetch path. Fallback to direct reads preserves correctness.

ops-bot: Update 07:39Z — prefetcher passive, additional instances online, error rate trending down. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/embed-store/us-west-2?orgId=1

Sam (eng-sre): Error rate dropped from 3.9% -> 0.6% after mitigation. Observed higher tail latency for a short window while caches warmed; monitoring for stabilization.

Rina (support): Status page updated and customer outreach sent to affected list. Sales notified for high-impact accounts.

Owen (infra): Keeping passive prefetcher until we root-cause the backlog; will replay prefetch backlog offline and re-enable when safe. Artifacts uploaded.

Elena (oncall): Postmortem owners: Sam + Owen. Closing criteria: errors <0.2% sustained for 10m and tail latency within baseline. Next update in 10m or on change.

ops-bot: Will auto-post final update when criteria are met. :white_check_mark:
